title: The measured panel decodes uniquely under mirror-y (raw y from 0 to -H)
rationale: Only the mirror-y hypothesis fits the stream. Nothing transforms emitted G-code into another frame, so uploads need the identity frame: refused, naming the design review a transform would need (safety-model 3.1 and 12; PHYS-01). The vertex frame is not yet a recorded fact (gate panel_vertices_usable off), so every hypothesis is still allowed (safety-model 12, step 2; U-13 in safety-model 1.4): once rung R2 has recorded the identity frame only the identity is tried, and the stream would fail it without naming a design review. The other gates are the baseline snapshot's. With the frame not a fact, uploads are gated off as well (G-GATE, gate panel_vertices_usable, rung R2); P-GEOM must still be among the refusals.
